## About
Fells Point Auto is an authorized safety inspection station in Maryland. Alongside inspections, we handle diagnostics, engine repair, tire work and oil changes for folks in Fells Point and around Baltimore.
Ali Syed is our auto inspector and Amir Sohaib is our mechanic supervisor. Our promise is simple: no upselling, no gimmicks, no faulty parts. We only recommend what your vehicle needs to stay on the road safely.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 97 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours too.

## Services
- Maryland Auto State Inspection: We're an authorized safety inspection station in Maryland. We check brakes, steering, lights, exhaust, safety belts and more.
- Diagnostics & Inspections: Thorough diagnostics using advanced diagnostic tools, with accurate assessments and customized solutions.
- Engine Repair: Check engine light, strange noises or a drop in performance. We diagnose it and use quality parts to restore your engine's power and reliability.
- Tire Repair: Our shop is fully equipped to handle the issues that affect the health of your tires.
- Tire Replacement: We can help you find the best prices for new tires when they need replacing.
- Tire Rotation: Keep your tires in good condition with regular rotation.
- Oil Change: A quick oil change with as little fuss as possible, with synthetic, synthetic blend and conventional motor oil brands on hand.

## FAQ
Q: What do you check during a Maryland safety inspection?
A: We check various parts of your vehicle, including brakes, steering, lights, exhaust, safety belts and more.

Q: If my car doesn't pass, do I have to get it fixed here?
A: No. We'll go over what needs fixing and give you a price. One reviewer noted we still gave them the option to take the car elsewhere.

Q: Do you handle the inspection paperwork?
A: Yes. One customer said we submitted the necessary documentation electronically at the same time we finished the inspection.

Q: Can you get me in quickly if something goes wrong?
A: We understand sometimes you can't wait for an appointment, so we work to book emergency appointments as quickly as possible.

Q: Do you work on anything besides cars?
A: Yes. Our shop has room for large and small vehicles, plus snow blowers, tractors, golf carts and other small engine needs.
